Reviews and ratings: Yandex Maps, Google Maps, 2GIS

Every review of every branch arrives in Telegram, a bad one reaches the manager within the hour with a drafted reply, and every customer is asked for feedback after the visit. An MVP in 2–4 weeks, from UZS 24 mln; the full version in 6–10 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline
MVP 2–4 weeksFull 6–10 weeks

light

Restaurants and cafes, Clinics, Hotels, Retail, Beauty salons, Car services and dealers, Fitness and sports

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Business profiles checked and completed on Yandex Maps, Google Maps and 2GIS
  • Reviews gathered into one Telegram feed per branch
  • AI-drafted replies in Uzbek and Russian for approval
  • Post-visit feedback bot that asks every customer for a score and a comment and gives everyone the review links
What the full version adds
  • Rating trends per branch and topic
  • Mentions of staff and dishes
  • Link to ai-complaints-desk
  • Monthly report
  • Reply time per branch
Please note

We never write, buy or filter reviews. Where a platform offers no reply API, your staff post the prepared replies.

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results
